_admin_note: Edit prices and inventory here. 'total' = spaces for sale, 'sold' = spaces already sold. The site shows 'X of Y available' and switches the Buy buttons to 'Sold out' when sold >= total. Prices are whole US dollars except deposits, which may have cents. Set a 'deposit' to null to offer pay-in-full only. For a product with no price yet (Premium Featured Listing), leave the prices null: the card shows 'Pricing coming soon' and an interest button. Set 'total' to null for online products with no inventory limit.
